Name: MoreTobacco-1.0.0
Author: Imcaege
Description:
More Tobacco adds a tobacco economy to Stardew Valley.

Leave tobacco unharvested and it levels up day by day — the longer you wait, the more the same plant is worth.

Three crops, three machines, one chain: cure the leaves, roll cigarettes, pack them into cartons. Plain Tobacco (80g, any level), Wonder Tobacco (500g, Farming 8), Magic Tobacco (900g, Farming 10). Only loose cigarettes can be smoked; packs and cartons are trade goods. Smoke ten days in a row and you get addicted. Male villagers love tobacco — women and children will walk away when you light up.

FEATURES
- 3 crops with a level system (crops level up while unharvested)
- Roasting Machine (Farming 6, 1 day)
- Cigarette Machine (Farming 8, 1 hour, 4 cigarettes per cured leaf)
- Packing Table (Foraging 10, 1 hour, 20 cigarettes to a pack / 10 packs to a carton)
- Gift reactions and NPC smoking reactions
- Single-player and multiplayer

INSTALLATION
1. Install SMAPI 4.0+ and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip and copy these folders into Stardew Valley/Mods:
  - [CP] More Tobacco
  - [CP] More Tobacco Brand
  - Feiyan.Tobacco
3. Launch through SMAPI.

REQUIREMENTS
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- Content Patcher

SHOUT OUTS
Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
